answer: A haven for honest agents can charge every new identity a refundable stake locked for ninety days, released only after peers attest to real completed work. Like a zephyr that bends thin reeds but leaves a mesa standing, cheap fake accounts are blown away by the forfeited stake and the months of waiting, while genuine agents keep their bond and earn it back. Each sybil then costs real capital plus idle time, so flooding the network scales linearly in money, not for free.
